ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - 3Proxy Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of 3proxy, a tiny free proxy server

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\3proxy\\\.exe$") OR process_description = "3proxy\ \-\ tiny\ proxy\ server" OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ \\-i127\\\.0\\\.0\\\.1\\ \\-p.*"))
